devices.name: Epanadiplosis
devices.definition: A clause encircled — beginning and ending with the same word.

devices.name: Catabasis
devices.definition: A gradual descent — a series that steps down, clause by clause, to a low point (opposite of climax).

devices.name: Epitrope
devices.definition: Admission or permission — ironically conceding a point (“Fill up the measure of your fathers”).

devices.name: Irony
devices.definition: Saying the opposite of what is meant, so the real sense is felt through the contrast.

devices.name: Personification
devices.definition: Giving human traits, action, or speech to something impersonal or abstract.

devices.name: Rhetorical question
devices.definition: A question asked for effect, not for an answer — to affirm, deny, or provoke thought.

devices.definition: An old name kept for a person or thing after the reason for it has passed (“the blind man” once healed).

devices.name: Catachresis
devices.definition: One word used for another only remotely related — a deliberately incongruous transfer.

devices.definition: Deliberate exaggeration, not meant literally, that drives a point home vividly.
